text:
Maya: Quick sync on the routing policies editor UI. Two problems reported: (1) drag reorder is jumpy when lists are long; (2) Preview sim keeps re-running during drag which causes flicker and intermittent error toasts. Screenshot + repro attached. Sam: I reproduced. When dragging item at index 9 toward index 2 it sometimes snaps to the top after a short pause. I suspect our virtualization layer + snap threshold math. Elena: Proposal: lower snap threshold and add a soft animation (fade+translate) so items don't appear to teleport. Also pause the Preview while a reorder gesture is active and show a subtle overlay that says 'Preview paused while editing rules'. Kevin: Note: I saw the toast flash 'Rule order saved' then flip to '400 Invalid rule precedence'. Backend sometimes returns 202 while the sim warms. We treat non-200 as failure right now. @Jia can you confirm? Jia: Correct — sim returns 202 then 200. Front-end treats non-200 as error. I'll update client to treat 202 as 'processing' and show an inline spinner by the Preview panel title. Plan: debounce the save by 120ms and poll once after 1s if we get 202. Will open PR tomorrow. Maya: Accessibility: a11y-bot flagged drag-handle contrast and tiny hit target. Need to increase clickable area to at least 44px, ensure visible focus outline, add aria-label and role="button" on the handle. a11y-bot: Automated scan: drag-handle.svg contrast 2.6:1 (fail); interactive target 16px (fail). Recommendations: larger hit target (>=44px), darker stroke or background for icon, add aria-grabbed/aria-dropeffect, and an aria-live announcement after keyboard moves. Sam: Copy nudge: instead of 'Invalid rule precedence' maybe 'Order not applied — check for locked rules or circular dependencies.' Short toast: 'Order not saved resolve dependencies.' Elena: Keyboard workflow: show Move Up / Move Down buttons when a row is focused (visible on hover+focus) and bind Alt+Shift+Up/Down to move. After move, announce 'Moved rule "X" to position N of M'. Also ensure Space/Enter triggers move in compact mode. Kevin: UX question: should Preview update live during drag or only after drop? My vote is pause while dragging to reduce noise and accidental sim runs. Maya: Agreed pause. Show a small non-modal overlay over Preview: 'Preview paused while editing'. When drop occurs, resume and run sim. Jia: I'll implement API ack handling and add an aria-live region snippet similar to:
Moved rule "Allow-Login" to position 4 of 10
Sam: Nice. Also can we soften the snap with a short transition and reduce the snap slab width. That should help orientation. Maya: Next steps: @Jia PR for API/ack handling + spinner; @Elena to craft copy strings; @Sam to mock animation + lowered snap; I'll prioritize a11y fixes (handle hit target + focus visible). Sync Friday 11am PT if needed. Elena: I'll add the accessibility checklist to the ticket: increase handle hit area to 44px; ensure focus-visible outline contrast >=3:1; add aria-live announcement; include keyboard-only move controls and tooltip with shortcut. Kevin: I'll add a regression test for the sim-flip and debounce the toast so it doesn't flash intermediate failures. Maya: Thanks team! Tagging this thread into the main routing editor design ticket. :seedling:
